requirements.description: atomic first-free O1–O5 claims and one clear sixth-claim failure
exact receipt, owner, generation, office, task, and project authorization
private same-task resume without receipt enumeration
exact-field, secret-free, nonmutating public status
no automatic expiry for pinned work
connected-project output enforcement against traversal, aliases, links, reparse points, 8.3 names, and delete/recreate identity changes
byte preservation for unknown residue and `recovery-required` before reuse
exact-key, office, and generation emergency release with evidence retention
all-free runtime activation, five independent equal runtime copies, and full rollback at every partial-failure point
an independent trust anchor that detects executable-plus-manifest substitution
truthful distinction among source-present, verified, tested, activated, and routed capabilities
no scheduler, hardware controller, automatic queue, stale auto-release, unsolicited network updater, or permanent background service
Continuing ordinary conversation does not imply pinned mode.
Conversation-only completion does not require a file deliverable.
Local Mission and platform Goal state reconcile or stop with an exact conflict.
Runtime versions are safe Windows path segments with physical containment.
Missing or corrupt resume pointers cannot create duplicate owner claims.
Normal claim output never exposes the raw owner key.
Resume proves task, chat, project, office, generation, and receipt identity.
Cancel and replacement checkpoint and execute an authorized release transition.
Office release and receipt/pointer retirement are crash-consistent.
Dirty normal release rejects or enters a distinct recovery state.
Suite fingerprints bind every semantic evidence input consumed by tests.
Qualification atomically records a hash-bound promotion state.
The critical matrix contains the exact current assertion set.
Readability gates constrain instruction lines without compressing semantics.
Root agent instructions retain the correct authority order.
Specifications name real manifest-builder code and tests.
Acceptance rows bind to test modules that exist.
Architecture, finalizer, verifier, and durable lifecycle agree.
Every public claim requires a validated connected-project binding.
